questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a benefit of transpiration for plants?

options.text: It drives the movement of water and minerals up the plant
It cools the leaves through evaporation
It helps maintain cell turgor with a continuous water supply

questions.explanation: Transpiration does not provide energy for photosynthesis (light does that). However, transpiration does drive water movement up the plant, transport minerals, cool leaves, and maintain turgor pressure in cells.
